notes.title: Open Beta Update
notes.notes: [p]Hi Fellows - Thanks so much for your patience and understanding as we try to resolve the server and queue issues we've experienced today. Trust us, we want you all to successfully get into the Beta -- we know you all have been waiting for it![/p][p]Wanted to share an update: The investigation surrounding the issues is still ongoing, and we're looking into every possible way of getting this resolved as quickly as possible. We've been actively investigating the issues since Open Beta began, and need a slight break to rest for a few hours (it's late in Sweden!) After some much needed rest, tomorrow, we will continue to troubleshoot and hope to resolve the issues.[/p][p]Thanks again for all of your support, and we hope everything will be resolved tomorrow so you all can jump into the Beta![/p]

notes.title: Early Access Launch Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="yBlcVdX5siY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Hi Fellows!

We’ve got an update for you regarding our planned Steam Early Access release date for Fellowship. In the video linked above, Community Director Hamish explains the release date update, upcoming changes and dives into a few other important topics!

[b]In case you’re in a hurry, here’s a summary of the video and a few additional notes:[/b]

[b]Steam Early Access Launch Date:[/b] We’ve made the decision to push back the release date by one week. 
[/p][p][h3]You'll be able to play Fellowship in Steam Early Access on October 16th instead of October 9th![/h3]

We know you all want to jump in the game ASAP (trust us, we can’t wait for you all to jump in!), but there are a couple of key reasons for this very small shift with the Early Access release date:

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/a39d794433e112ae2269e9bfb72e8dd18654cdf0.jpg"][/img][/p][p][i][b]More time for changes & polish[/b]:[/i] The slight delay gives us the opportunity to put in extra polish and ensure the best possible experience for you all on day one when Fellowship enters Steam Early Access! As you all know, we’ve been having our private playtest recently – which has helped us identify changes we can make to the game. Having some additional development time, even if it's only a week (a week goes a long way!) will allow us to make the changes and polish we want to make so Fellowship is the best it can be when it enters Early Access on October 16th!  [/p][p][/p][p][i][b]To address the elephant in the room[/b] – we want to give Fellowship it’s time to shine[/i]: There are major game releases happening the week we originally planned to enter Early Access. Following Gamescom, we saw your all’s concerns about launching Fellowship during a major week for highly-anticipated game releases and recognized of course you all (like us!) wanted to make sure Fellowship has its time to shine in the spotlight. We always want to be transparent with our community and get your feedback, and this is no different! By launching Fellowship in Steam Early Access on October 16, it allows us to make sure the game does get in the spotlight and get the attention we and you all think it deserves!

[b]Open Beta – No changes:[/b] No changes here, we absolutely can’t wait for you all to jump in! The Open Beta via Steam will still kick off on Thursday, September 18 at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time and end on Tuesday, September 23 at 10:00 a.m. Pacific Time. For the Open Beta, there will be a North America, Europe and Asia server available, and servers will be online 24/7! You can request access to the Open Beta via the game’s Steam page to be notified immediately when the Open Beta goes live.

At the very end of this blog, we have an Open Beta FAQ with quite a few answers to questions folks have asked since we announced the Beta. Make sure to check it out!

[b]Leagues System & Matchmaking Updates:[/b] The Leagues System will be a new way to experience progression throughout Fellowship! With the system, you’ll be able to make your way through different leagues as your experience, gear, and item level improves. Matchmaking will set you up with players of similar item level, and you will then be able to pick a dungeon of suitable difficulty. Prepare to complete dungeon runs, enter higher leagues, and reap exciting rewards!

Our matchmaking game modes will remain about the same but will have some quality-of-life changes to make matchmaking even better. For modes, we’ll have Quick Play, and for now, what we’re calling Challenge (previously known as Ranked or Ranked Dungeons). Quick Play, like before, offers a more casual experience that’d give you a chance to try out new heroes, and not have to worry about gear as your gear will not matter but you’ll of course still have all your usual abilities per character! Our Challenge mode (name to be decided!), will have the Leagues System and really dive deep into the game’s progression, as you’ll work your way up to harder difficulty dungeons. The higher the league you’re in, the more challenging and rewarding dungeons will be!

[b]Localization:[/b] Right at Steam Early Access launch on October 16, Fellowship will be playable in the following languages: English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Korean, and Chinese! The game will launch in your chosen Steam language or default to English if it’s not supported.

[b]Fellowship Content from Creators:[/b] Leading up to our Open Beta and during the beta, you’ll be able to watch some of your favorite creators play Fellowship on Twitch and YouTube. Beyond Open Beta, there’ll be even more content from press and content creators to be shared before, on and even after Early Access launch. Keep an eye on our social media channels and join our Discord to not miss out on anything!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/636ac1b9229b99365b2113b864778af867766c6d.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Open Beta FAQ[/b][/h3][p]If you made it this far, thanks for sticking around! Below’s a quick FAQ addressing some questions we spotted since we announced the Beta. We’ll share this FAQ again when the Open Beta launches, so no need to memorize it!

[b]There really is no signup, payment or key required?[/b]
Correct, there is no need to sign up, key or fee required for the Open Beta! It’ll be open to everyone!

[b]How do I get into the Open Beta?[/b]
During the time of Open Beta from September 18 to September 23, you can head to Fellowship’s Steam page, click the “Join the Fellowship Playtest” to download the Open Beta build, and once it’s downloaded, you can jump in and play. 

If you’d like immediately to know when the Beta is live (or just need a friendly reminder!), you can request access now via Fellowship’s Steam page.

[b]When can I play exactly?[/b]
The Open Beta runs from September 18 at 10am PT (7pm CEST) to September 23 at 10 am PT (7pm CEST) and Fellowship will be fully playable for that whole time.

[b]Can I stream/capture my gameplay?[/b]
There will be no NDA for this Open Beta. Streaming/video capture and talking about the playtest is highly encouraged!

[b]What Heroes are available?[/b]
There will be 7 heroes for players to choose from during the Open Beta: 2 Tanks, 3 DPS, and 2 Healers. We’ll most notably have a new Melee DPS, Mara, available, and be bringing back Ardeos, everyone’s favorite fire-throwing DPS! 

[b]Will there be any new content in the Open Beta compared to the last playtest back in February?[/b]
There will be! Compared to the Steam Next Fest demo back in February, in addition to introducing a new DPS hero, Mara, the Open Beta will introduce new gameplay systems, including a fresh take on matchmaking and group finding, and an engaging progression system including Weapons, Gems, Talents, Crafting, Legendary items and more. Additionally, the Open Beta will introduce a new dungeon “Urrak Markets”, new gameplay features like cosmetic customization allowing you to change the look of different pieces of armor, new Gear, new Mounts, new visual element improvements and improvements on previous gameplay mechanics based on Steam Next Fest player feedback. The Open Beta will allow us to test multiplayer matchmaking improvements we’ve made and give us the chance to get one final round of player feedback before Fellowship’s Early Access launch.

[b]Will there be servers in my region? [/b]
There are NA, EU, and Asian servers available during the Public Playtest.

[b]What languages are the Open Beta available in?[/b]
We are planning to have the Open Beta available in English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Russian, Korean, and Chinese.

[b]How do I share my feedback?[/b]
[url="https://discord.gg/playfellowship"]Join our Discord![/url] Feedback can be shared in the ⁠#game-feedback channel.

[b]What do I do if I encounter an issue during the Open Beta?[/b]
As this is still a Beta build, you may occasionally encounter issues with your game. If you do, please report them in the ⁠#bug-reports ⁠channel on Discord so our teams can track them.

notes.title: Developer Update: Public Playtest Wrap-Up & What’s Next
notes.notes:
Hi Fellows! 

It’s been just a little over a month since our Public Playtest (demo) for Steam Next Fest – which ICYMI went extremely well to say the least (see the infographic below) – but we wanted to take a moment to share a Developer Update video that addresses your playtest feedback, how we plan to improve Fellowship based on the feedback and what’s next for the game as we get it ready for Early Access launch. Be sure to check out the video as it has a few things we’ve been working on lately based on your feedback! 

[previewyoutube=c9zv5T6l-tQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129917/877a7834db0ad7db3e8c830ea08b068006139a41.jpg[/img]

We’ll be spending the next few months focused on developing Fellowship, but don’t worry, we won’t be silently working.  We will still be giving you all updates as we continue development. Updates will include sharing news (yes, that includes news of the Early Access release date – we’ll have news on that when we’re ready!), videos/trailers, dev team blogs, and last but certainly not least giving you all a chance to take a look on what we’re working on along the way.  

Aside from giving wider updates, we also have our Fellowship Community Council, our new community program where we’ve hand-picked and will continue to hand-pick a group of players – from competitive players to players that are new to this type of game, and give these players the chance to connect directly with us! For the program, folks that are in it can get exclusive access to in-development builds of Fellowship (under NDA, of course) and give us feedback in real-time to shape the future of our game. If you’re interested in joining the council, send Hamish, our Community Director, a DM via Discord, share with him why you’d be a good fit, and he’ll make sure to add you to the list for consideration to join the council. 

That’s it for today’s dev update, but we’re thrilled to continue development on Fellowship after all the incredible feedback we got from you all from the Public Playtest! We can’t wait to share more updates as we work on getting Fellowship ready for Early Access launch later this year.  

Cheers, 

Chief Rebel Team

notes.title: Public Playtest Patch Notes - March 1
notes.notes:
Hi Fellows! 

We'll be releasing a patch today to fix crashes and add some balancing changes. We'll be bringing down the servers temporarily for maintenance as well. ⚒️ 

Below are the notes for today's patch.

[h3][b]GENERAL
[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Discovered and fixed another issue causing crashes related to cooldown recovery.
[*] Fixed an issue causing players who rejoin an ongoing dungeon to not be targetable.
[*] Fixed an issue causing players who rejoin an ongoing dungeon to not get loot from the end of dungeon chest.
[*] Players who rejoin an ongoing dungeon that have an empty health bar will no longer need to restart the game again. The health bar will update upon taking damage.
[*] Fixed an issue causing all ability cooldowns to reset when players rejoined an ongoing dungeon.
[/list]

[h3][b]RELICS
[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed the tooltip for Blood Rite Drums. Now correctly states that it provides +50% Cooldown Recovery for the duration of the effect.
[*] The cooldown of Blood Rite Drums has been increased to 3 minutes, up from 2.5 minutes.
[*] The cooldown of Salt Wash Elixir has been reduced to 2 minutes, down from 5 minutes.
[*] The cooldown of Ancient Wardstone has been reduced to 2 minutes, down from 5 minutes.
[*] The cooldown of Sinbinding Stone has been reduced to 3 minutes, down from 5 minutes.
[*] The cooldown of Chalice of Al'zerac's Essence has been reduced to 3 minutes, down from 5 minutes.
[/list]

[h3][b]RIME
[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Rime Talent: Avalanche now causes Icy Comet to have a 20% chance to strike twice and a 4% chance to strike three times, down from 30% / 8%.
[*] Rime Talent: Soulfrost Torrent now increases the damage of Freezing Torrent by 50%, down from 100% - resulting in a total of 200% increased damage on a full channel considering the increased duration of the channel still being double.
[*] Rime Talent: Soulfrost Torrent's proc per minute reduced to 1.5 (was 2.0).
[*] Rime Talent: Winter's Blessing now converts 30% of damage to healing, down from 100%.
[/list]


[b][h3]SYLVIE
[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Safe Haven cooldown reduced to 120 seconds, down from 180 seconds.
[*] Safe Haven duration increased to 15 seconds, up from 12 seconds.
[*] Safe Haven damage reduction increased to 25%, up from 20%.
[*] Fluttercall: Jubilee now redistributes health in the group every 2 seconds, down from every 3 seconds.
[/list]

[h3][b]TARIQ[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Focused Wrath now increases the damage of your next two Skull Crushers or Hammer Storms by 50%, up from 30%.
[*] Raging Currents damage increased by 50%.
[/list]

[h3][b]STORMWATCH & DEMONBRAND RUINS
[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Mancatchers will now wait longer after initiated to use their Grip ability.
[*] Mancatcher's Grip damage reduced by 40%.
[*] The minimum range of Mancatcher's Grip ability has been increased to 1500, up from 1000.
[/list]

[h3][b]SAILOR'S ABYSS
[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Vengeful Shade's Witherbane Toxin now deals damage every 3 seconds, up from every 2 seconds.
[*] Coral Lasher's Disgorged Muck cooldown increased to 12 seconds, up from 8 seconds.
[*] Water Elemental's Hydro Bolt cooldown increased to 15 seconds, up from 12 seconds.
[/list]

[h3][b]THE WYRMHEART
[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Coldheart Assassin's Wicked Strikes damage reduced by 20%.
[*] Coldheart Assassin's Poison Dagger damage reduced by 35%.
[*] Greater Ice Elemental's Stomp ability damage reduced by 28%.
[/list]

notes.title: Public Playtest Patch Notes - February 28
notes.notes:
[h3]GENERAL[/h3]
[list]
[*] We have increased the maintenance warning timer to 30 minutes, up from 15 minutes. Unfortunately, this requires us to patch the game, so this patch will be the last one with a 15-minute warning.
[/list]
[h3]STABILITY[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed another issue causing crashes when players used Cooldown Reducing talents or effects and Cooldown Recovery. This is the issue that was primarily affecting Rime players, but should also prevent crashes for all heroes related to cooldown reduction.
[/list]
[h3]SPIRIT ABILITY UPDATE[/h3]
[list]
[*] Spirit ability charge lost upon death has been reduced to 25%, was 50%.
[/list]
[h3]TARIQ[/h3]
[list]
[*] Auto Attack / Heavy Strike damage increased by 10%.
[*] Leap Slam damage increased by 15%.
[*] Raging Tempest's tooltip incorrectly stated that Raging Currents increases critical strike chance by 1.5% per stack. Now correctly states each stack increases critical strike chance by 1%.
[*] Culling Strike's base damage increased by 33%.
[*] Added information on Culling Strike's tooltip to clarify that the ability does not affect the swing timer.
[*] Intimidate cooldown reduced to 150 seconds, down from 180 seconds.
[*] Intimidated enemies can now take 100% more damage before the fear breaks.
[*] Talent: Blood & Thunder now increases Chain Lightning damage by 25%, up from 20%.
[/list]
[h3]HELENA[/h3]
[list]
[*] Helena's maximum Toughness value is based on her strength (1200% of Strength baseline). This has been increased to 1800% Strength.
[*] Helena's Toughness generation from Shields Up, Shield Slam & successful blocks is also based on her strength. All three abilities now have 50% increased Toughness generation.
[*] The above 2 changes cause Toughness generation to function the same as before, while reducing the amount of Toughness lost when taking damage, improving her overall damage mitigation.
[*] The amount of Toughness generated by successful blocks has been increased by an additional 25% (from 4% Toughness per block, to 5%).
[*] Shields Up duration increased to 12 seconds, up from 8 seconds.
[/list]
[h3]MEIKO[/h3]
[list]
[*] Serenity no longer has a global Cooldown.
[*] Stone Shield is now more resilient. The health of each stone has been increased by 33%.
[*] Talent: Spirited Advance had an issue causing the free applications of Spirited Strikes and Spirited Vortex to not work properly. This has been fixed. 
[*] KNOWN BUG AND REQUEST: Meiko's "Spirited Advance" talent is causing lag spikes. Until we have a chance to fix it, we recommend Meiko players to not use that talent for now. Sorry for the inconvenience! 
[*] Talent: Harsh Winds tooltip clarified to indicate that the attack speed slow only affects enemy auto attacks.
[*] Talent: Forbidden Technique now accumulates 15% of all damage you deal to the target, up from 10%.
[/list]
[h3]RIME[/h3]
[list]
[*] Talent: Glacial Assault now requires 4 stacks to activate, down from 5.
[/list]
[h3]SYLVIE[/h3]
[list]
[*] Talent: Bluey's Gambit damage reduction when placed on another player increased to 10%, up from 5%.
[*] Talent: Bloomin' Boomshrooms now heals allies near the target for 75% intellect per explosion, up from 50%.
[/list]
[h3]PROGRESSION[/h3]
[list]
[*] All types of Ingots and Aethers will now continue dropping as the difficulty increases.
[*] Ingot and Aether drop chances continue increasing up to difficulty 24.
[*] End of dungeon group loot UI updated to support showing up to 8 items for players, as there now is a small chance for players to get all 3 Ingots, all 3 Aethers, an Item, and a Gem in a single chest.
[*] Fixed an issue with the 'Might of the Minotaur II' ruby gem power causing it to only provide 1% increased intellect for intellect heroes. It now correctly increases intellect by 10%.
[*] Fixed an issue with item scrapping UI, causing items in the scrap window to become scrapped when a player pressed the "Eject Gem" button.
[/list]
[h3]CURSES[/h3]
[list]
[*] Blood Shards damage reduced to 2.5%, down from 3% (tooltip incorrectly stated 4%, now updated to 2.5%).
[*] Binding Ice now roots the afflicted player for 3 seconds, down from 4 seconds.
[*] Meteor Rain's fragments now have 10% smaller hit boxes.
[*] The killscore break points that cause Malevolent Spirits to appear is now every 12% in dungeons and 24% in adventures, down from every 10% in dungeons and 20% in adventures.
[*] Carnage now causes 10% of all damage dealt by players being replicated as healing on the group, down from 20%.
[*] Challenge now increases non-boss enemies' health and damage by 10%, down from 15%.
[*] Ultimatum now increases boss health and damage by 10%, down from 15%.
[/list]
[h3]DEMONIC RITUAL[/h3]
[i][b]PROPHET EZ'RATH[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Wicked Hook ability is now visible on the boss timer.
[*] Increased minimum range of Wicked Hook to 1500 (was 1000).
[*] Wicked Hook's initial damage reduced by 35%.
[/list]
[h3]ICE CAVES[/h3]
[i][b]ELDRIN ASSASSIN[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Poison Dagger initial damage reduced by 24%.
[/list]
[h3]CITHREL'S ASCENT[/h3]
[i][b]BLADE OF CITHREL[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Ice Breaker damage reduced by 17%.
[/list]

notes.title: Public Playtest Patch Notes - February 26
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for playing during our Fellowship Public Playtest at Steam Next Fest, and for providing [url=https://discord.gg/6xrCTVbMj2]valuable feedback and bug reports on our Discord[/url]! We have pushed a hotfix that addresses several issues, check out the complete patch notes below.

[h3]QUICKPLAY[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed Quickplay issues where premade groups sometimes could not play quickplay.
[*] Fixed an issue of new players being unable to play when the matchmaker queued them into a party with a premade group.
[*] Fixed several issues causing longer queue times in Quickplay. We are keeping an eye on this to see if there are any more issues after this patch.
[/list]
[h3]STABILITY[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a few cases where the reduction of cooldowns caused a crash. This is a crash that would be more prevalent for certain heroes and talents (in particular Helena and Rime playing with their cooldown reduction talents). There may be more cases, so we will continue keeping an eye on this. Thank you for your patience.
[*] Fixed an issue causing some players who start the game to get in a situation where regions are "offline", even though they are not.
[/list]
[h3]PROGRESSION[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing some materials in the chest at the end of dungeon to be less than 1. Now, when players complete any dungeon or adventure that is high enough difficulty to award a certain material, they will receive at least 1 of that resource.
[*] Fixed an issue causing some bonuses from certain Gem Powers to be lost upon death.
[/list]
[h3]HERO BALANCING UPDATE[/h3]
[i][b]SYLVIE[/b][/i]
[list]
[*] Boomsplosion damage reduced by 15%.
[/list]
[h3]DUNGEON BALANCING UPDATE[/h3]
[i][b]DEMONIC RITUAL[/b][/i]

notes.title: Public Playtest Patch Notes - February 25
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for playing during our Fellowship Public Playtest at Steam Next Fest, and for providing [url=https://discord.gg/6xrCTVbMj2]valuable feedback and bug reports on our Discord[/url]! We have pushed a hotfix that addresses several issues, check out the complete patch notes below.

[h3]PROGRESSION[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue causing items for 10+ dungeons to be stuck in the mailbox. You can now continue gaining items at high difficulties.
[*] Players can now claim any items that were in their mailbox since yesterday retroactively.
[*] ilevel15 items now award proper Gold when scrapped.
[/list]
[h3]STABILITY[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed crash when leaving the tutorial.
[*] Fixed crash when going to a dungeon with the talent windows open.
[/list]
[h3]TARIQ[/h3]
[list]
[*] "Thunder Call" ability tooltip updated to no longer have the text "Generates 25 Fury".
[/list]
[h3]VIGOUR[/h3]
[list]
[*] Radiant Blast was incorrectly gaining 100% increased damage during Avatar of Faith, now correctly increases damage of Radiant Blast by 50% for the duration.
[*] Dawnbreaker Orb damage reduced by 35%.
[*] The talent "Ruptured Soul" now explodes for 25% of the damage remaining in any active Soulbrands when the enemy is killed (was 50%) - Rune Power generation remains at 50%.
[/list]
